name: FGATE2_ST_IDLE
meaning: SetState 0: anim CLOSED (closed) or OPEN (hidden, contact off) (inferred)

name: FGATE2_ST_OPENING
meaning: SetState 1: anim MV_OPEN, one-shot freezes the Wolf and locks the button; Update: raises the box, -> 0 (inferred)

name: FGATE2_ST_FALLING
meaning: SetState 2: anim MCLOSE2A at openAnimMs/fallingTimeMs speed; Update: -> 3 when the area is clear (inferred)

name: FGATE2_ST_SLAM
meaning: SetState 3: anim MCLOSE2B, box lowered, closed = 1; Update: on anim end -> 0 (inferred)
